assets.subject: A horizontal chained violet ghost flame tethered to a folded cream collateral contract with a large golden clasp. Clear left ghost and right paper silhouettes, no writing.
An open teal accounting ledger on the left sends three gold coins along a small curved golden stream into a round glass alchemical retort on the right. One compact horizontal composition.
One squat dark teal ceramic fermentation crock with a sealed cream cloth lid, crimson wax clasp, and curled violet cursed vapor wrapping its rim. Tiny orange ember below. Wide simple composition.

One shallow golden plate in the center receives orange carrot pieces from a teal serving spoon at left and luminous turquoise reagent from a purple glass vial at right. Two streams meet into a bright small swirl above the plate. Horizontal, no feast.
A compact golden locking seal with a violet ghost-shaped jewel trapped in the center and two short chain links. Chunky round clasp silhouette.
One small teal and gold abacus with three rows of big gold beads; its right upright is a miniature turquoise glass flask. Clearly an abacus, bold rectangular silhouette.
One enchanted charred cooking ladle with a curved plum handle, copper bowl and one bright purple-orange ember floating in the bowl. Diagonal silhouette.
One matching fork and butter knife crossed like a crest, one teal enamel handle and one purple enamel handle, warm gold blades, short cream ribbon at crossing. Four-pronged fork clearly visible.

A double office access badge on a short loop of lanyard: two overlapping ID plates, teal plate with a simple gold sun shape and purple plate with a cream crescent. No faces or writing. Big recognizable twin rectangles.
A small round burgundy leather drawstring pouch with two cream playing cards protruding, teal cord and a simple gold clasp. One soft round silhouette, cards have only plain diamond shapes.

One upright closed crimson document folder, battle-worn corners reinforced with gold, thick ivory papers inside, a large shield-shaped teal clasp centered on the front. Compact rectangular closed folder, no lettering.

A broad low teal wooden office inbox tray with brass corner braces, stacked cream folders and two contrasting purple and orange index tabs. Wide horizontal tray silhouette, clearly open at front. No writing.

A squat animated stockroom audit automaton, body made of a chunky open teal stock ledger with cream paper edges, small brass spectacles over glowing amber eyes. One hand holds a large brass balance scale with two trays, other hand grips a rolled inventory sheet with abstract grid only, no writing. Stout broad triangular silhouette, teal brass and cream palette, two tiny floating paper feet.

A tall narrow hovering bureaucratic ghost examiner in a crisp purple magistrate office coat made of folded papers, cream angular collar, dark face with two cyan eyes. One outstretched hand holds a large teal rubber stamp, the other a crimson rubber stamp. Two blank cream sheets hover by shoulders. Tall elegant diamond silhouette, purple crimson and cream palette, pointed coattail.
